name: GitLab PR detail: host link, draft, read-only posting and host-omitted diff
description: Spec 2026-10-16-gitlab-merge-requests (AC-49, AC-37, AC-39, AC-43, AC-51). From the seeded GitLab repo's PR list, opens PR #5 (route keyed by PR number) and asserts the 'View on GitLab' action targets the merge-request URL, the Draft badge, and on the Files changed tab the read-only posting note, the renamed file 'old → new', 'Diff too large on GitLab' (in Original order — Smart order collapses the boilerplate lockfile group) and the host-omitted notice. The 'View on GitLab' control is a button that calls window.open (no href), so the flow stubs window.open, clicks it, and reads back the captured URL. Persisted data only — DEVDIGEST_HOSTS_OFFLINE=true. Assumes the hermetic runner (scripts/e2e.sh) with SEED_GITLAB_FIXTURE=1.
